text: dsh-session-stats-panel 是面向 DSH Web 的会话统计面板，在页面右侧的 shell.overlay 区域显示当前会话的模型、缓存命中率、费用估算、DeepSeek 余额、运行时间、请求数和累计 Tokens。它从会话投影和模型 RPC 读取统计数据，按 DeepSeek 峰谷价格估算成本，并通过服务端余额路由读取账户余额。面板可收起为按钮；余额查询可使用 credentials 服务或 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。适合需要在 Web 会话中查看用量与成本的用户。

dsh-session-stats-panel adds a right-side DSH Web panel for current-session token use, cache-hit rate, runtime, request count, model, and estimated DeepSeek cost. It also shows account balance through a server route and can collapse. Balance lookup uses credentials or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

dsh-session-stats-panel 的功能「会话用量面板」：在 Web 页面右侧展示缓存命中率、累计 Tokens、运行时间和模型请求数。面板从当前会话统计投影读取数据，并可收起。
dsh-session-stats-panel 的功能「费用估算」：依据当前模型和会话 token 分项，使用 DeepSeek 峰谷价格估算人民币费用；非 DeepSeek 模型不计价。价格按查看时刻选择。
dsh-session-stats-panel 的功能「账户余额」：页面加载后向插件服务端路由请求余额，并每两分钟刷新。服务端从 credentials 或环境变量读取 DeepSeek 密钥，再调用余额接口。
dsh-session-stats-panel 的功能「会话模型显示」：面板通过 sessions.models 查询当前会话的模型，并在标题区域显示模型名称；切换会话时重新读取，调用失败则清空模型信息。
dsh-session-stats-panel 使用前须知：账户余额功能需要服务端可解析的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并会向 api.deepseek.com 请求余额；密钥保留在服务端，浏览器只请求插件路由。

dsh-session-stats-panel README · 📊 监控指标看板：| 核心指标 | 数据源与计算方式 | 业务价值 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **平均命中率** | `cacheReadTokens / 计费输入 Tokens` | 直观评估 Prompt Caching 优化效果 |
| **会话估算费用** | 按照 DeepSeek 官方峰谷价格表动态计算 | 精确核算单次 Agent 任务运行成本 |
| **剩余账户余额** | 服务端凭据隔离路由拉取（每 2 分钟刷新） | 避免 Key 暴露前端的同时实时监控余额 |
| **累计 Tokens** | 未命中输入 + 缓存读写 + 输出（千分位展示） | 掌握上下文膨胀与消耗规模 |
| **模型请求次数** | 会话中模型调用步骤（`steps`）计数 | 监控 Agent 思考轮数与工具调用频次 |

text: dsh-session-stats-panel README · 📄 开源许可证：本项目采用 [MIT License](LICENSE) 授权开源。
dsh-session-stats-panel README · dsh-session-stats-panel：A DeepSeek Harness (cordis) **client plugin** that shows a stats panel for the current session on the right side of the page:

dsh-session-stats-panel README · dsh-session-stats-panel：| Metric | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Average hit | Share of cache-hit input tokens (`cacheReadTokens / billed input`, accumulated across whole-round logs, 3-decimal precision) |
| Session cost | Accumulated cost estimated with DeepSeek official pricing (DeepSeek models only, see pricing below) |
| Remaining balance | DeepSeek account balance (read by the host route; the key stays server-side; refreshes every 2 minutes) |
| Runtime | Accumulated LLM + tool execution time |
| Requests | Number of closed model steps (`steps`, i.e. model request count) |
| Cumulative tokens | Input (miss) + cache-read + cache-write + output, shown with thousands separators (e.g. 3,251,237) |

dsh-session-stats-panel README · dsh-session-stats-panel：The panel registers in the framework's `shell.overlay` layer (a list slot — it stacks rather than replaces any existing UI), is pinned to the right edge of the page, and collapses to a small pill when you click the "–" in the title bar.

dsh-session-stats-panel README · Pricing：Cost is estimated in the browser with a price table built into the plugin (CNY / million tokens, fetched from the [DeepSeek official pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing); cache writes are billed at the cache-hit price).

**Official peak/off-peak pricing rules** (peak windows are weekdays only, Beijing time 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00; everything else — including all of Saturday and Sunday — is off-peak, priced at half the peak rate):

dsh-session-stats-panel README · Pricing：| Model | Period | Cache-hit input | Cache-miss input | Output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| deepseek-flash | off-peak | 0.02 | 1 | 4 |
| deepseek-flash | peak (weekday peak hours) | 0.04 | 2 | 8 |
| deepseek-v4-pro | off-peak | 0.15 | 4.5 | 13.5 |
| deepseek-v4-pro | peak (weekday peak hours) | 0.30 | 9.0 | 27.0 |

CNY per million tokens; cache writes are billed at the cache-hit price.

dsh-session-stats-panel README · Pricing：`deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) and `deepseek-v4-pro` (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813) are the current official ids. The retired `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` ids are still callable — requests are served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and billed at Flash prices — so they share the Flash row. Versioned ids (`deepseek-v4-pro-0813`, `deepseek-v4-flash-0731`) resolve to their family rather than the fallback, and any other `deepseek-*` model falls back to the Flash price.

dsh-session-stats-panel README · Pricing：The plugin auto-selects the price tier at "view time" (peak / off-peak; hover the cost row to see the tier). Session cost is an **estimate**: cumulative tokens cannot be sliced by time, so the whole amount is priced with whichever tier is active at view time.

dsh-session-stats-panel README · Via the bundle manifest (recommended)：```bash
dsh plugin add github:a1113622001/dsh-session-stats-panel
```

The plugin ships a `cordis.patch.yml` bundle patch, so the `plugin add` command installs it as an installable plugin that activates automatically (no manual loader row needed).

dsh-session-stats-panel README · Manually from a local directory：1. Install the dependency (equivalent to `dsh plugin --profile web add <this directory>`):

```powershell
   corepack pnpm --dir "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web" add "C:\Users\baiyec\Desktop\Harness\plugins\dsh-session-stats-panel"
   ```

2. Append a loader row to `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: session-stats-panel
         name: 'dsh-session-stats-panel'
   ```

dsh-session-stats-panel README · Manually from a local directory：3. Restart the web service (`dsh web`). Afterwards, edits to `lib/client.js` are picked up by client-hot-reload (no browser refresh needed).

dsh-session-stats-panel README · Development：```bash
npm test        # run the pricing/derivation unit tests
node --check lib/*.js   # syntax-check every JS file
```
